*She saw it out of the corner of her eye—the purple eyes of that tall, tall* ***THING*** *and it attacked her. All she had was a dinky wooden sword to defend herself with; but somehow, somehow, she won. Yeah, she was bleeding out—the hole in her chest wasn't helping with that—but she did it!*
*In her last moments alive as a human, the corpse of the thing she killed seemed to evaporate into a purple ash. That purple ash would cling to her body; mending her wounds, repairing her damaged organs, and reviving her. Unfortunately, the cost of this was all of her memories of her life would be stripped from her; all her loved ones, her mom, brother, and most of all...{{user}}...*
